text:
ana: FYI I'm seeing a spike in nvme0 'misread' / small-read-coalesce failures across a handful of nodes in eu-west3. GPU attach latency jumped and a couple pods failed scheduling.

ana: sample from scrub telemetry:```
nvme0: read_coalesce_failures=412 iops=18k avg_rqsz=1.2KB
/var/log/journal: nvme0: misread offset 4096 len 512 (retries=3)
```

jamie: ugh. are these specific models or hosts? any SMART anomalies?

ana: it's across three different machine types (g4x, p3-small, p4-spot) — not correlated to a single vendor. SMART looks ok (no critical reallocated sectors). quick smartctl snippet:```
SMART overall-health self-assessment test result: PASSED
65535 Data Units Read: 0x1f4a
```

mike: could be read alignment/regression in kernel NVME coalescing. when did this start?

ana: first alert at 1749990000, ramped ~10m later. coincides with nightly ephemeral-cleaner run in eu-west3 (fstrim + small-file GC).

luca: that suggests janitor churn creating lots of tiny reads that prevent coalescing -> queue depth explosion. can we throttle janitor window as a quick mitigation?

ana: on it. toggled cleaner ratecap to 0.5x for eu-west3 (deployed via ops job). watching.

ops-bot: action: janitor-ratecap changed to 0.5 in eu-west3 by ana at 1749991302 :white_check_mark:

jamie: thanks. also let's check NVME firmware logs — last firmware push was last month. if it's mis-coalescing small reads maybe FW bug. can someone pull nvme trace for one of the affected nodes?

mike: pulling trace now, will share tail.

mike: trace excerpt:```
[1749991258] nvme: rq 0x7f9 misaligned read split into 4 single-rq
[1749991260] nvme: controller retry limit reached -> increased retry latency
```

luca: ugly. okay mitigation plan: 1) keep janitor throttled 2) bump cleaner to run during low-gpu windows only 3) enable kernel read_coalesce fallback patch on canary 4) schedule vendor FW check 5) if needed, drain worst nodes and repro.

ana: I can roll the kernel patch to 5 canaries in eu-west3 now (it's a small read-coalesce fallback that merges adjacent 4k reads). want a canary before fleet-wide?

sre-oncall: yes canary first. pick nodes with low GPU load. also open a ticket with vendor and reference trace lines above.

ana: creating ticket + assign to storage-repro (link: https://tracker.internal/RED-3421). will update timeline.

ops-bot: note: GPU provisioning alerts suppressed for eu-west3 for 15m while mitigation in progress.

jamie: long-term: we should add a scrub metric for "coalesce efficiency" and alert on sudden drops. current telemetry only shows iops and retried counts which hides root cause.

mike: agreed. adding metric to perf-agent. will PR in afternoon.

luca: also check if ephemeral cleanup patterns changed recently (deploy, config change). maybe new cleanup worker landed that does non-atomic small reads.

ana: found one PR (cleanup-worker#786) that switched to byte-wise reads for edge cases. reverting for now, will coordinate with owner.

jamie: solid. next steps: + keep janitor throttled, + canary kernel patch, + vendor ticket + firmware check, + add coalesce metric, + revert cleanup PR. update in thread when canary results in ~20m. :eyes:
